items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 22.04.2026. The period runs 10 calendar days 'nach Rechnungsdatum'. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (22.04.) is not counted, so counting starts 23.04.2026. 10 days later lands on Saturday, 02.05.2026 (§ 188 BGB). Since this is a private-law calendar-day deadline falling on a Saturday, § 193 BGB shifts it to the next business day, Monday, 04.05.2026 (Friday 01.05. is a public holiday - Tag der Arbeit - so it could not serve as the fallback either).
